claims.claim: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot undocked from the ISS at 12:05 GMT on 7 October 2026.
claims.episode_span: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot and her Crew-12 crewmates undocked from the International Space Station at around 12:05 GMT on 7 October 2026.
claims.source_title: Watch Sophie Adenot return to Earth
claims.supporting_quote: On 7 October 2026, ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot and her Crew-12 crewmates will undock from the International Space Station at around 12:05 GMT/14:05 CEST to begin their journey back to Earth.

claims.claim: Hubble recorded roughly 100 unidentified chemical features in 1999 observations of white dwarf HS 0209+0832.
claims.episode_span: The element was first recorded in 1999 among roughly 100 unidentified chemical features.
claims.source_title: A breakthrough Hubble discovery shows signs of a planet forming after its host star's death
claims.supporting_quote: Hubble first observed the white dwarf in 1999, in the process recording roughly 100 chemical features that had remained unidentified.

claims.claim: Arctic sea ice reached 4.6 million square kilometers on 12 September 2026.
claims.episode_span: Sea ice extent hit its lowest point on 12 September 2026 at 4.6 million square kilometers.
claims.source_title: Arctic Sea Ice Shrinks to Its 2026 Minimum
claims.supporting_quote: Sea ice in 2026 reached its annual minimum extent on September 12 (above), when it covered an estimated 4.6 million square kilometers (1.78 million square miles), according to NASA and the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC).
